AC5 post-fix measurement recorded. Before-rate remains the partitioned rate from the RCA: 4/40 recent Gerrit Verified Gate runs failed in checkout with the HTTP 504/RPC/packfile signature; host-side upload-pack data showed 12/37 CI substantive fetches (32.4%) over the old 60s read-gap ceiling, replicated at 2/6 (33%).

After the live nginx reload at `2026-09-06T01:05:39Z`, I queried GitHub Actions for Gerrit Verified Gate runs created after that cutoff: 14 total, 12 non-cancelled, 12 successes, 0 failures. Post-fix rate for the same partitioned checkout-transport/504 failure class: `0/12 = 0.0%` (the two cancelled runs were superseded patchsets, not 504s). This satisfies AC5 without using the raw 55% headline.
